question: Compute the past-24-hour CryptoPunks time-weighted last-sale price on Ethereum mainnet, in integer wei, using only onchain sale events, receipts and block timestamps. Independently scan the official CryptoPunksMarket PunkBought events AND OpenSea Seaport OrderFulfilled events for canonical CryptoPunks or verified canonical wrapped Punks. Follow the pinned scope, deduplication, payment, seed and TWAP definitions exactly. This is a sale-price TWAP, not a listing floor, simple average, or VWAP. Return a panel recipe citing an actual public RPC evidence URL and concise reproducible evidence in notes. Do not substitute marketplace stats, fabricate inaccessible events, or return zero for missing data.

definitions.seed: Find the latest qualifying sale strictly before S from the same union of venues, looking back at most 7 days before S. Apply identical filters. This seeds price at S. If no seed or complete source coverage cannot be established, report inability instead of inventing a value, shortening the denominator or using the first later sale.
definitions.dedup: Verify receipts and ownership/payment legs. Deduplicate overlapping venue events for the same economic sale; identify by transaction, punk ID and actual transfer/order. Preserve distinct real sales in one transaction. For overlapping coverage prefer the complete Seaport payment over PunkBought. Exclude internal custody/wrapping legs, refunds and duplicated fee legs.
definitions.scope: Ethereum mainnet canonical CryptoPunksMarket 0xb47e3cd837ddf8e4c57f05d70ab865de6e193bbb, token IDs 0..9999. Include canonical wrapped Punks only after verifying their contract, underlying custody and token-ID mapping from primary sources and onchain state. Exclude V1, replicas, other chains and unverified wrappers.
definitions.output: Write only artifacts/answer.json using a supported panel recipe; recipe.source is the actual public RPC URL used, without credentials. Notes <=4000 characters: S/E, actual scanned blocks, contract scope, per-venue counts/exclusions, dedup count, seed tx/time/price, exact weighted numerator and denominator, answer, evidence digest and representative tx hashes, RPC checks and limitations.

Match NFT contract/token to scope. Seaport is permissionless: label these Seaport fills; do not claim OpenSea UI attribution from the event alone. Report zero matching fills explicitly.
definitions.window: Let E be the timestamp of the pinned toBlock and S=E-86400. Verify toBlockHash. Resolve the first block at/after S by RPC timestamps, even if it precedes pinned fromBlock. Include qualifying events with S<=timestamp<=E and block<=toBlock. Use actual block timestamps, never estimated block duration.
definitions.formula: Sort unique sales by (blockNumber,transactionIndex,logIndex), with the matched Seaport log as canonical when deduplicated. Carry seed price from S to first sale; each subsequent sale replaces price until next sale or E. Same-timestamp events contribute zero until the last ordered event. Answer=floor(sum(priceWei*durationSeconds)/86400) using integer arithmetic. Include the seed even if no in-window sales.
definitions.evidence: Use eth_getLogs with adaptive chunking, receipts and block timestamps from mainnet RPC. Verify decoded payment and NFT legs. Attempt a second independent RPC to cross-check log completeness and final numerator. No CoinGecko/OpenSea stats, listing APIs, search snippets or offchain price aggregates as price evidence. Report precise access failures; partial scans are not a complete answer.
definitions.payments: Only positive ETH/WETH purchases; treat WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 at 1:1 with ETH. Decode both offer and consideration for Seaport sales/bids; total buyer payment including fees, without double counting. Exclude bundles with multiple NFTs, mixed/other currencies, gifts, zero-price and same buyer/seller. Do not infer sale price from Transfer alone.
definitions.limitations: This is a last-trade time-weighted series over heterogeneous NFTs; sparse trades or unusually priced Punks can dominate it. It is not a floor or manipulation-resistant valuation. Evidence is panel agreement on an onchain-derived computation; the deployer does not independently reproduce this TWAP recipe.
